protocol.tolerant_accuracy_definition: A predicted phase at time t is accepted when the same ground-truth phase occurs within [t-1 s, t+1 s] in the same contiguous sequence.
protocol.full_sequence_f1_definition: Strict framewise labels across every valid held-out frame; no tolerance.
protocol.transition_matching_definition: Same from-phase and to-phase, nearest unused predicted event within +/-1 s.
